**Ashtakavarga charts of Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn** (South Indian style, printed page 230)

Five separate 4x4 charts are printed on this page, each labelled in its hollow centre. Bindus are printed as numerals here rather than as dots. The Lagna marker `L` is printed in Leo on the Mercury, Venus and Saturn charts; it is not printed on the Mars or Jupiter charts, so it is shown only where the book shows it. Houses below are counted from Leo.

| House | Sign | Mars | Mercury | Jupiter | Venus | Saturn |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (Lagna) | Leo | 5 | 5 | 7 | 5 | 7 |
| 2 | Virgo | 4 | 6 | 7 | 4 | 6 |
| 3 | Libra | 4 | 4 | 2 | 5 | 4 |
| 4 | Scorpio | 2 | 5 | 5 | 4 | 3 |
| 5 | Sagittarius | 2 | 5 | 6 | 3 | 1 |
| 6 | Capricorn | 4 | 4 | 5 | 4 | 3 |
| 7 | Aquarius | 3 | 4 | 3 | 6 | 3 |
| 8 | Pisces | 2 | 4 | 3 | 3 | 2 |
| 9 | Aries | 4 | 4 | 5 | 4 | 2 |
| 10 | Taurus | 4 | 5 | 5 | 3 | 4 |
| 11 | Gemini | 3 | 4 | 4 | 6 | 3 |
| 12 | Cancer | 2 | 4 | 4 | 5 | 1 |
| | **Total** | **39** | **54** | **56** | **52** | **39** |

Each total matches the standard bindu total for that planet (Mars 39, Mercury 54, Jupiter 56, Venus 52, Saturn 39).

Beneath the charts the page prints a four-cell strip reading `19 | 26 | 33 | 28`, which continues on the following page.
